seed_principle: without a known circle arc, retain every elementary native cell incident to the free endpoint; do not choose a preferred side or triangle orientation
all_orientations: the other five seed sets are the D6 rotations of the base set; each has 6 cells with two seeds on each of shells 0,1,2

aggregate_geometric_seed_set.theorem: union of all six orientation seed sets is exactly B_2={C:SHELL(C)<=2}

orientation_provenance: orientation tags may be retained when counting path provenance; duplicate geometric cells are not deleted from an orientation-tagged analysis, but the canonical set-valued geometric seed union contains each cell once
triangle_orientation_dependence: U/D have different local neighbor formulas but the shell/FAR theorems are D6-covariant and orientation-independent at the structural level
